extracted.name: Baked Vegetables
extracted.description: An easy recipe for cooked vegetables. Potatoes, onions, broccoli, and zucchini are baked in a casserole dish with dried soup seasoning for flavor.
ingredient_lines: 1 head fresh broccoli, cut into florets
1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly oil a large, shallow baking dish.
Combine broccoli, carrots, zucchini, and potatoes in the prepared baking dish and lightly salt. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with dry soup mix.
Bake in the preheated oven until vegetables are tender and easily pierced with a fork, 30 to 45 minutes.
